name: Harness, context, sub-agents and recursion ranked
purpose: Harnesses are ranked by cost and time at the same pass rate, across the context given to them and their use of sub-agents and recursion.
record: A balanced score of pass rate, cost and time for each setting, on the same cases.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=hubofhubs/the_world/tools/delegated_agent_sessions/tests/test_deep_session_subagents.py passes] > public [real=no | when=graded public evidence for the arms exists at grade C or better] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real deep session runs end to end and is hand-read] > measured [real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved]

name: Goal met by its own tests (agent sessions)
purpose: A general task that is not coding counts as done only when the agent's final report holds every expected fact, the run says it met the goal and the files are unchanged.
record: Cases passed over twelve general tasks (read and report, compare, count, put in order), with calls, tokens and cost. The authoritative score is the balanced score of [balance.agent_sessions] in esoi.toml (pass rate with cost per case and seconds per case, stated weights and budgets).
disadvantages: Does not see unrequested changes to other files, and public problems may be known to the model.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=competitive | when=changes made against a throwaway workspace by a fake model] > public [real=no | when=graded public evidence for the arms exists at grade C or better] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample did not decide]
command: esoi run agent_sessions --impl stream_json_goal_runner; esoi run agent_sessions --impl subprocess_goal_runner; esoi run agent_sessions --impl acp_deep_runner; esoi run agent_sessions --impl none
